newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil model seeks soap opera career after coma.
newsitem.headline: Brazil model seeks soap opera career after coma.

text.p: Top Brazilian model Claudia Liz, who went into a four-day coma after plastic surgery went wrong, said on Wednesday she was feeling fine and could not wait to get on with her soap opera career, national SBT television reported.

Speaking to the reporters for the first time since waking up Saturday from her coma, the 27-year-old blonde said she could not remember what happened during the ill-fated liposuction operation but had not lost her memory of her life before.
"I've woken up, I'm okay," she said in the interview broadcast by SBT. "I don't know what happened but I know all about my life before."

Asked by journalists what she would do next, the six-foot (180 cm) model said she would "dedicate herself to a soap opera career." She has already played some minor roles in Brazilian television series.
Liz suffered a cardiac arrest after developing an allergy to general anaesthetic shortly before the liposuction operation to remove excess flab from her stomach.
The accident sparked a furious debate about the Brazilian obsession with beauty, which drives a quarter of a million of them into the clinics of plastic surgeons every year.
Liz underwent surgery to remove a mere four pounds (two kilos).
She said she had no plans to go under the doctor's knife again. "On no, that's over," she said.
